question: In September 2024, India surpassed which milestone in renewable energy capacity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**200 GW.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India achieved the milestone of 200 GW installed renewable energy capacity in September 2024, marking a 14% year-on-year increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana installed rooftop solar panels, boosting solar energy capacity to 94 GW.**
 
• **The National Green Hydrogen Mission promoted green hydrogen to reduce fossil fuel imports and carbon emissions.**
 
• **The milestone aligns with India’s Panchamrit goals to achieve 500 GW non-fossil fuel energy capacity by 2030.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Panchamrit Goals**__

 __
 
• Announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during COP26 to combat climate change.
 
• Targets include achieving 500 GW non-fossil fuel energy capacity and reducing carbon emissions by 1 billion tons by 2030.
 
 
 
• **National Green Hydrogen Mission**__
 
 
• Aims to position India as a global hub for green hydrogen production and export.
 
• Seeks to reduce carbon emissions and create over 6 lakh jobs by 2030.
